# Payment Calendar: Extended Reference

Official site: https://payment-calendar.app/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6757201533

## What Payment Calendar Is
Payment Calendar is a bill and payment planner for iPhone and iPad (iOS/iPadOS).
It is designed for people who want a clear monthly view of due dates and paid items,
without using a full budgeting platform. Payments are entered manually — the app
does not connect to bank accounts, does not import transactions, and does not track
income or account balances.

## Version and Requirements
- Current version: 2.1.0
- Requires iOS/iPadOS 18.0 or later
- Supported devices: iPhone and iPad only
- Not available on Android
- watchOS support is planned but not yet available
- Not available as a web app

## Core Capabilities
- Monthly calendar for due payments
- Payment reminders (local notifications)
- Mark paid / edit / duplicate actions
- Editable "date paid" field, independent of the due date, for already-paid items
- Search by name, amount, or notes
- Wide currency support, including regional currencies such as Colombian peso,
  Mongolian tögrög, Mexican peso, Chilean peso, and New Zealand dollar, with
  formatting adapted to the device region
- iPad support

## PRO Capabilities
- Recurring payments and subscriptions
- Statistics and trends
- Home screen widgets
- iCloud sync across a user's Apple devices
- CSV/PDF export

## Pricing
Core features are free with no account required. PRO unlocks recurring payments,
statistics, widgets, iCloud sync, and export. PRO is offered as a monthly
subscription, an annual subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase, priced
per App Store region. Subscriptions are managed and cancelled through Apple ID
settings, same as any App Store subscription.

## Privacy Positioning
- No account required
- Local data by default
- Optional iCloud sync when enabled by the user (PRO)
- No third-party advertising or analytics SDKs
- No bank account connection or transaction import

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Does Payment Calendar connect to my bank account?
A: No. Payments are added manually. The app does not use bank integrations or
   transaction aggregation.

Q: Is Payment Calendar available on Android?
A: No, it is iOS/iPadOS only.

Q: Is there an Apple Watch app?
A: Not yet; watchOS support is on the roadmap.

Q: Does it work offline?
A: Yes. No internet connection or account is required. Data stays on-device
   unless the user enables optional iCloud sync (PRO).

Q: Is it a budgeting app?
A: No. It tracks bills and payments (due dates, paid status), not income,
   account balances, or budgets.

Q: How is user feedback handled?
A: Users can contact the developer directly at payment_calendar@icloud.com;
   feature requests and missing-currency reports are read and answered
   individually.
